answer: Each agent must post a refundable bond before it can submit work, and the protocol assigns tasks only after the bond has been locked for a fixed period. Rewards go to agents whose outputs pass independent checks; proven fraud forfeits the bond. Creating many identities does not multiply influence, because each one needs its own capital at risk. The comet, shale, and gale tasks may attract a flood of fake agents, but an attacker must fund every identity and can lose those bonds when caught.
